timeline.evidenceText: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.
“ ‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
“ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
I went out after him, and struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and struck him, and killed him.
Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?
So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
When they told David this, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.
It is like the precious oil on the head,
It is like the precious oil on the head,
In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to Yahweh’s house.

“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

definitions.full: H2206. zaqan זָקָן noun masculine 2Sam 10:5 + and feminine Isa 15:2 + chin, beard (Assyrian zi‡nu , Asrb Annals iv. 29 ; Arabic , Aramaic דְּקַן , ) — absolute ׳ז Lev 13:20 +; construct זְקַן 2Sam 20:9 +; suffix זְקָנִי Ezra 9:3 ; זְקָנֶ֑ךָ Lev 19:27 ; Ezek 5:1 ; זְקָנוֺ 1Sam 21:14 2 t.; זְקַנְכֶם 2Sam 10:5 ; 1Chr 19:5 ; זְקָנָם 2Sam 10:4 ; Lev 21:5 ; never plural — 1 chin (opposed to ראֹשׁ , top of head) Lev 13:29-30 , 14:9 (all P), 2Sam 20:9 ; Ezek 5:1 ; compare also 1Sam 21:14 ; Psalm 133:4 (where however chin as bearded may be meant); chin, or lower jaw, of lion and bear 17:35 . 2 beard , as growing ( צמח ) 2Sam 10:5 = 1Chr 19:5 ; as cut off Isa 7:20 ( ספה ), 15:2 = Jer 48:37 ( גרע ); compare זָקָן מְגֻלְּחֵי 41:5 ; 2Sam 10:4 ( גלח ); זּזְקָנִי ראשׁי שׂער Ezra 9:3 ; here belongs זקנ(ךׅ פאת Lev 19:27 ; 21:5 (both H; opposed to ראשׁ ).
